what: The analyst agent's verdicts up to November 2020, learned by a small model from the FinBERT vectors of the material filings it read and the stock's card, then applied to every stock-month with a material filing. Only this model's output feeds the scorer; no language model's reading of 2021-2026 reaches the book.
reading: Mean monthly rank correlation with next month's return, on the same answered stock-months, t across months. If the analyst beats the small model by far more in 2021-2026 than in 2015-2020, the gap is recall. In 2015-2020 the small model was fitted to these same verdicts.
